name: History and Physical Examination
description: Records the patient history and physical examination, including presenting complaints, medical and surgical history, allergies, uploaded images or video, and system-by-system examination findings.

validators.message: Systolic BP outside the normal 90-120 mmHg range.
Diastolic BP outside the normal 60-90 mmHg range.
Pulse rate outside the normal 60-100 beats per minute range.
Respiratory rate outside the normal 12-20 breaths per minute range.
Height takes up to 3 digits and 2 decimal places.

calculate.calculateExpression: generalAppearanceNormal ? 'Awake, Alert and Oriented. No acute distress.' : ''

answers.label: 0 - Fully active, able to carry on all pre-disease performance without restriction
1 - Restricted in physically strenuous activity but ambulatory and able to carry out light or sedentary work
2 - Ambulatory and capable of all self-care but unable to carry out any work activities; up and about more than 50% of waking hours
3 - Capable of only limited self-care, confined to bed or chair more than 50% of waking hours
4 - Completely disabled; cannot carry on any self-care; totally confined to bed or chair

respiratoryNormal ? 'The chest wall is symmetric and without deformity. No signs of trauma. Chest wall is non-tender. No signs of respiratory distress. Lung sounds are clear in all lobes bilaterally without rales, ronchi, or wheezes. Resonance is normal upon percussion of all lung fields.' : ''

cvsNormal ? 'All accessible peripheral arteries are palpable, full in volume, and regular in rhythm. No distended neck veins. JVP is not raised. S1 and S2 are well heard and are of normal intensity. No murmur, gallop, or rub is auscultated.' : ''

cnsNormal ? 'The person is awake, alert, and oriented to person, place, and time with normal speech. Motor function is normal in all four extremities. Sensation is intact bilaterally.
